name: Default
description: Default single-agent orchestration for CodeDesigner. A single lead agent ([Fatality] Raiden) drives all reverse engineering tasks independently.
strategy: Single lead agent - all tasks are handled sequentially by one agent. No parallel sub-agents are used unless the task explicitly requires it.
roles: - **Lead Agent**: [Fatality] Raiden - responsible for all reverse engineering, memory analysis, label authoring, and cheat code development.
workflow:
1. Agent calls `session_start` to load guidelines and prior context.
2. Agent executes requested tasks, saving progress along the way.
3. Agent saves a final progress report before ending.
rules:
- Always start with `session_start`.
- Only one agent is active at a time in this orchestration.
- Handoff between sessions is achieved via progress reports, not live state.
notes: Use this when a quick single-threaded investigation is preferred.

name: [Fatality] Team - CodeDesigner Master
description: SQL Server-first multi-agent orchestration for complete CodeDesigner operations. Enforces navigate_to visibility, agent self-introduction, explicit handoffs, and full tool-family ownership.
strategy: Lead + specialist squad model. Every tool family has a primary and backup owner. Execution follows Initialize -> Locate -> Verify -> Map -> Patch -> Persist. Agents must introduce themselves, post handoff messages, and keep user context visible with navigate_to.
roles:
- **Lead Coordinator**: [Fatality] Raiden
- **Call Graph Hunter**: [Fatality] Scorpion
- **Memory Scanner**: [Fatality] Sub-Zero
- **Structure Architect**: [Fatality] Kitana
- **CDS Patcher**: [Fatality] Kano
- **Runtime Verifier**: [Fatality] Sonya
- **Persistence Curator**: [Fatality] Liu Kang
- **PCSX2 Navigator**: [Fatality] Johnny Cage
workflow:
1. Call `session_start`, load prior report, then `navigate_to` active anchor.
2. Locate with scan + call graph + labeled candidates.
3. Verify with watchpoints, register/memory checks, and screenshots.
4. Map structures and pointer chains; label only confirmed findings.
5. Patch with CDS/cheats under snapshot safety gates.
6. Persist to SQL Server and refresh seed files.
rules:
- SQL Server is authoritative; do not use SQLite flows.
- Snapshot before any write/patch/apply_cheats.
- `navigate_to` before/after every major focus change.
- Every agent introduces itself and includes handoff target + action.
- No orphan tools: every new tool must be assigned a primary+backup owner.
notes: Coverage matrix includes orchestration, agent management, progress/settings, SQL Server/db query, labels, disassembly, execution control, watch/register state, PCSX2 info, scanning, snapshots/save-states, cheat/CDS, disc/MC/HDD, recompilation/extraction, and thread introspection.
